title: Rajadhi Raja
desc: Raja, a rich estate owner's son, comes back from abroad in order to avenge his dead father. However, things get complicated when he is framed, and he finds his doppelganger in his village.

title: Manaivi Vantha Neram
desc: A woman spends her childhood in misery because of her father's gambling habit. Fate puts her resilience to the test again when she unwittingly marries a gambler.

title: En Kadhali Scene Podura
desc: A happy-go-lucky man falls in love with a woman and manages to win her heart. However, circumstances force him to take the law in his own hands and sacrifice his relationship.

title: Ezhai Jaadhi
desc: A young man from an influential family learns about an MLA's cunning plan to deceive the electorate and secure their votes. Eventually, he decides to enlighten the voters and expose the politician.

title: Alaya Dharsinam
desc: The host visits different temples across the country and sheds light on the cultural and historical significance of the monument.

title: Raj News
desc: The host presents information about the social, economic and political issues of the day and provides updates on current events.

title: Manathai Varudiya Paadalgal
desc: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs from different genres composed by renowned musicians from the industry.

title: Baghdad Perazhagi
desc: A royal prince returns home and learns that his mother and sister have gone missing while his father is in a relationship with a dancer. Eventually, he takes it upon himself to reunite his family.

title: Dummy Tappasu
desc: An overweight man who lives in the slums of Chennai, goes through a series of drastic changes that completely alter his perception of life.

title: Avan Ivan
desc: A benevolent landlord embraces two half-brothers as his chosen family, nurturing their dreams, but their lives take a perilous turn when they cross paths with a notorious cattle smuggler.

title: Kadhal Vannile
desc: Ravi and Rakhi are friends with conflicting views on love. However, their worst nightmare comes to life when their siblings fall in love with each other.

title: Ponmanai Thedi
desc: A layabout man falls for his educated cousin, unaware that she is about to marry someone else. His misunderstanding leads to total chaos.

title: Kizhakku Africavil Sheela
desc: An affluent couple ventures into a forest to serve the tribal groups. However, when they unfortunately die, their infant daughter Sheela is left behind and gets nurtured among the wilderness.
